params.body:
`EvaluationDTO::fromArray()` passed `$data['creator']` straight into
`UserDTO::fromArray()`, which takes an `array`. When the teacher who created the
evaluation has been deleted the value is `null`, PHP throws a `TypeError`, and
the failure is not scoped to that one evaluation: the whole progress report and
the whole deliberation report of that student return a 500.

Measured on production data while rehearsing the Laravel 13 upgrade: two
students in 2024-2025 and eleven in 2023-2024 cannot open their report for this
reason. It has been that way since the DTO layer was introduced; the upgrade did
not cause it and did not fix it.

## What changed

- `EvaluationDTO::$creator` is `?UserDTO`. `fromArray()` passes `null` when the
  key is absent or null, and `toArray()` emits `null` for it.
- The three screens that render the creator ask with `?->`. The JavaScript in
  `reporting/dashboard/projects/show.blade.php` already guarded
  (`fullName(person) => person ? ... : ''`), so it needed nothing.
- A test that pins it: a payload with `'creator' => null` builds, and round
  trips as `null` rather than throwing.

A report that shows one evaluation without a teacher's name is readable. A
report that 500s is not.

## Checks

- `php artisan test`: 196 passed, 1 failed (`BuildStampTest`, which reads the
  build stamp out of the checkout and only passes in a full clone, not a
  worktree).
- `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse`: no errors.
- `vendor/bin/pint --test`: passed.
params.title: Een verwijderde maker breekt geen rapport meer
